scenes.text: Imagine flying high over France in 1918, frantically searching the dark horizon for the beautiful city of Paris to drop a payload, only to realize later that you actually bombed a complete illusion.
To protect their beloved capital from devastating German air raids, French authorities secretly designed and constructed an entire duplicate city just a few miles north of the real, bustling Paris.

This mind-blowing decoy featured miles of fake wooden streets, replica monuments, and complex theatrical lighting systems designed to perfectly mimic a glowing metropolis at night, even simulating moving trains.

The war luckily ended before this massive optical illusion could be fully tested by enemy pilots, but would you have been fooled by this giant fake city? Hit that follow button for more incredible history secrets!
